headline: CHINA MULLS RADICAL GOLD TRADE OVERHAUL — PROPOSALS WOULD STRIP PBOC OVERSIGHT, FREE PHYSICAL FLOWS WORLDWIDE
snippet: Chinese authorities are reportedly considering a new import and export regime for gold that would significantly limit People's Bank of China oversight of physical bullion flows — a step beyond the April 30, 2026 multi-use permit expansion (effective June 1) that already extended permit validity to nine months and eliminated transaction frequency limits. The proposed structural overhaul, reported by Kitco on June 29, would redefine who supervises China's gold trade at a fundamental level, with implications for the global physical market given that China imported approximately 692 tonnes of gold through May 2026, a 76% year-on-year increase.

headline: STAR COPPER DOUBLES BC PORPHYRY FOOTPRINT — ZYMO AND INDATA ACQUIRED FROM EASTFIELD FOR 10M SHARES (CSE:STCU)
snippet: Star Copper Corp. (CSE:STCU) signed a definitive agreement with Eastfield Resources Ltd. on June 30, 2026 to acquire a 100% interest in the 18,184-hectare Zymo Copper-Gold Porphyry Project near Smithers, British Columbia and Eastfield's 95.3% interest in the 4,551-hectare Indata Copper-Gold-Molybdenum Project — in exchange for 10 million Star Copper shares. The transaction adds more than 20,000 metres of historical drilling and multiple drill-ready porphyry targets, establishing Star Copper as a three-project BC copper-gold company with substantially expanded exploration upside at a moment when Canadian copper jurisdiction stories command a premium in the market.

headline: BENZ LINKS HURRICANE ZONES 126 AND 102 — 400M DOWN-PLUNGE CORRIDOR DOUBLES UNDERGROUND SEARCH SPACE AT GLENBURGH (ASX:BNZ)
source_name: Investing News Network / Benz Mining Corp.
snippet: Benz Mining Corp. (ASX:BNZ / TSXV:BZ) announced on June 29-30, 2026 that drilling at its 100%-owned Hurricane Camp within the Glenburgh Gold Project in Western Australia's Gascoyne region has confirmed thick high-grade gold mineralisation linking Zone 126 and Zone 102 for the first time — materially expanding the camp. First-pass drilling more than 400 metres down plunge of Zone 126 intercepted 2 metres at 6.4 g/t Au including 1 metre at 11.9 g/t Au in hole 26HZ163, opening a major new underground growth corridor that potentially doubles the Hurricane search space atop a camp that already hosts an estimated 31–35 Mt at 2.50–2.72 g/t Au for 2.5–3.0 million ounces gold.

headline: MITHRIL COPALQUIN RESOURCE: 615K OZ AuEq AT 75% INDICATED, DISCOVERY COST UNDER $20/OZ AFTER 60,000M IN MEXICO (TSXV:MSG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Mithril Silver and Gold
snippet: Mithril Silver and Gold Limited (TSXV:MSG / ASX:MTH) released a mine-constrained, dilution-adjusted Mineral Resource Estimate on June 30, 2026 for Target 1 at its Copalquin Project in Durango State, Mexico — totalling 615,000 oz gold equivalent, of which 75% (464,000 oz AuEq) now sits in the higher-confidence Indicated category, a 196% increase over the prior MRE. The Indicated component grades 3.15 g/t Au and 77.8 g/t Ag across 3.391 million tonnes, and the overall discovery cost across 60,568 metres of diamond drilling in 204 holes is less than US$20 per ounce AuEq — a strong efficiency metric for a district still in active expansion.

headline: GOLD X2 EXPANDS MOSS MAIN ZONE — 32.8M AT 1.22 G/T AU FROM 166M, INFILL MRE UPDATE TARGETS Q4 2026 IN ONTARIO (TSXV:AUXX)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Gold X2 Mining
snippet: Gold X2 Mining Inc. (TSXV:AUXX) released June 30, 2026 assays from its ongoing infill and resource expansion drilling at the Main Zone of the Moss Gold Project in Northwest Ontario, confirming multiple shear zones near surface including 32.8 metres at 1.22 g/t Au from 166.2 metres — demonstrating that the Moss Main Zone, which received limited historical drilling, continues to expand beyond existing resource outlines. Gold X2 has now drilled approximately 100,000 metres at Moss, which hosts a current Indicated resource of 2.458 million ounces at 1.04 g/t Au across the Moss and East Coldstream Deposits; an updated MRE incorporating Main Zone expansion is planned for Q4 2026 or Q1 2027.

headline: KODIAK TRIPLES MPD DRILL TO 16,500M, ADDS SECOND RIG — KETCHAN LEADS 7-DEPOSIT EXPANSION BLITZ IN SOUTHERN BC (TSXV:KDK)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Kodiak Copper Corp.
snippet: Kodiak Copper Corp. (TSXV:KDK) announced June 29, 2026 that its 2026 exploration program at the fully funded MPD copper-gold porphyry project in southern British Columbia has been expanded from 6,500 metres to 16,500 metres with the addition of a second diamond drill rig — accelerating resource growth across all seven MRE deposits, each open to expansion in multiple directions. The Ketchan deposit is leading Phase One with 2,546 metres across 14 holes completed to date, and first assay results are expected shortly; an updated MRE incorporating 2026 results is planned for 2027. The program timing is deliberately positioned ahead of any clarity on U.S. copper tariff decisions that would further improve economics for Canadian-jurisdiction copper projects.

headline: ACLARA ACHIEVES 99% RARE EARTH PURITY IN NEW SPREC PRODUCT — BYPASSES MREC BOTTLENECK AT CARINA AND PENCO MODULE (TSX:ARA)
snippet: Aclara Resources Inc. (TSX:ARA) announced June 29, 2026 the successful development of Super Pure Rare Earth Carbonate (SPREC) — a product containing approximately 99% rare earth content, versus the 45–60% typical of conventional Mixed Rare Earth Carbonate (MREC) — achieved at the company's pilot plant in Santiago, Chile by applying solvent extraction know-how from its U.S. downstream separation platform upstream within its Circular Mineral Harvesting process. The SPREC will be integrated into both the Carina Project (Brazil) and Penco Module (Chile), reducing downstream processing burden for heavy rare earth buyers and differentiating Aclara's output in a market where Western REE separation capacity remains acutely constrained.

headline: ARGENTA SILVER MAPS 20+ TARGETS AT EL QUEVAR — MANI-COPAN FOOTPRINT 500M × 90M, YAXTCHÉ EXPANDS 20% (TSXV:AGAG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Argenta Silver Corp.
snippet: Argenta Silver Corp. (TSXV:AGAG) reported June 30, 2026 that systematic surface exploration across its El Quevar Silver Project in Salta Province, Argentina has now identified more than 20 priority targets at varying stages of advancement — including the Mani-Copan target, a newly delineated 500-metre by 90-metre footprint with the same high-grade geochemical signature as the flagship Yaxtché Deposit and three confirmed mineralised levels. The Yaxtché Deposit footprint itself has expanded 20%, adding 270 metres of strike from approximately 22,000 metres drilled since May 2025 (13,000 metres in 2026 alone), with roughly 40% of assays still pending — creating significant near-term newsflow potential for what is emerging as a district-scale silver system.

headline: BOLIVIA ABANDONS 15-YEAR DOLLAR PEG — BOLIVIANO FALLS 30% AS WORLD'S 5TH-LARGEST SILVER PRODUCER SEEKS IMF LIFELINE
snippet: Bolivia ended a 15-year fixed exchange rate on approximately June 26-27, 2026, replacing the 6.86 boliviano-per-dollar peg with a freely floating rate that opened around 9.73 bolivianos per dollar — an implied devaluation of roughly 30% — as La Paz pursues a multibillion-dollar IMF financing package to address chronic foreign reserve depletion and a parallel currency market that had made the official peg increasingly untenable. Bolivia is the world's fifth-largest silver-producing nation and a significant zinc and tin producer; while the currency float reduces Bolivian operating costs in dollar terms and could modestly improve production economics for local mine operators, severe macro instability and IMF conditionality present material project development risk for any operator or explorer with Bolivian exposure.

headline: GOLD IN OFFICIAL BEAR MARKET AT -20% FROM JAN PEAK — OANDA: Q2 2026 MONETARY HEADWINDS RESHAPE ENTIRE PRECIOUS METALS COMPLEX
snippet: OANDA's June 2026 gold market overview concludes that all four major precious metals — gold (-20.1% from January's $5,589 high), silver (-39.6%), platinum (-35.5%), and palladium (-39.7%) from their 2026 peaks — have entered official bear market territory by the end of Q2, driven by Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish recalibration of rate expectations and the June 15 U.S.-Iran ceasefire eliminating the safe-haven premium that had contributed to January's record prices. OANDA frames Q2 2026 as a structural reset rather than a bull market termination, noting that central bank demand floors (244 tonnes in Q1), structurally tight mining supply, and the probability of an eventual Fed pivot remain intact — and that the severity of the correction is compressing valuations on gold equities to levels not seen since mid-2024.
